messages:
jordan: PAGER: GitHub Actions is failing for prod-deploy pipeline — all runs show 502 on actions.githubusercontent.com API. First noticed by Sentry alerts hitting on failed deploys at 14:02 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-03-15-GHAUTH
maya: I'm on it, grabbing logs. CLI failing with `cannot fetch actions artifact` and `403` for some package fetches.
liam: same, our hotspot is `actions/cache` step and `npm install` pulling private packages from npmjs.org — errors: "EAI_AGAIN" and "Request failed with status code 503".
emily: Confirmed — status.github.com shows partial outage for Actions and Packages in us-east-1. https://www.githubstatus.com/
jordan: Impact: blocks hotfix builds and deployments. We have a customer-facing page showing degraded deploys. On-call: maya (sre), liam (eng), sergio (release).
maya: Initial mitigation plan: 1) try reruns? 2) if GH Actions API still down, build artifacts locally and push images manually to our registry; 3) ship hotfix via direct k8s image update.
liam: Reruns are failing consistently. I'm starting a local build on my laptop and then will push image to gcr.redwood-inference.com/sandbox/hotfix:1794.
sergio: I'll prep a manual rollout playbook, adding steps for canary and rollback. Also contacting GitHub support — raised ticket 1234567.
emily: Ops note: our release runner uses `GITHUB_TOKEN` for artifact uploads; if actions.githubusercontent.com is down, uploading artifacts won't work. We should avoid requiring artifact upload for the manual path.
maya: Steps I recommend:
- Build container locally: `docker build -t gcr.redwood-inference.com/hotfix:1794 .`
- `docker push` using CI creds stored in HashiVault
- Update deployment: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=gcr.redwood-inference.com/hotfix:1794 --record`
- Monitor logs/traces and rollback if errors > 1% 5m
liam: I can run the build in CI-less way using our self-hosted runner on ec2 (it's healthy). That bypasses GitHub hosted Actions but still uses the runner to execute workflow. However the workflow uses `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` but those are local steps so should work — main failure point is remote artifact/cache and npm registry.
jordan: Good call. Are our self-hosted runners allowed to access our npm proxy? We have an internal Artifactory mirror `npm.redwood-internal`.
liam: Yes, I can set NPM registry env: `npm config set registry https://npm.redwood-internal/` and run `npm ci --prefer-offline`.
sergio: If npm registry also has issues, fallback is to use the last-good build image from our internal image cache. We keep previous images for 30 days.
maya: While liam attempts self-hosted run, I'm adding a mitigation to the incident header: "Degraded: GitHub Actions/API + GitHub Packages impacting deploys; manual image push path active". Notifying customer success.
emily: CS notified two customers on affected list, provided ETA: investigating. :phone: 
jordan: Update from GitHub Support: they confirm issues with Actions infrastructure currently investigating, estimated resolution unknown.
liam: Self-hosted runner build started, hit an auth error uploading to our npm proxy: `401 Unauthorized` — looks like the CI token used on the runner is stale.
sergio: I'll rotate the CI robot key (deploy-bot) and update runner env. Quick steps: create new token -> store in Vault -> restart runner.
maya: Doing the handoff — I'm going off-shift in 20m; @liam you'll be primary. Jordan, keep incident lead.
jordan: Acknowledged. Handing over to liam. I'll stay in the channel for exec updates.
liam: I rotated token, restarted runner, build resumed. If this passes we can push image and trigger manual rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy request received: manual-image-push by liam
liam: Build succeeded, pushed image to gcr.redwood-inference.com/hotfix:1794. Starting canary with 5% traffic.
maya: Monitor metrics: latency, error rate, token cost. Use the canary dashboard under Console -> Rollouts.
sergio: Canary shows 0.2% errors, similar to baseline. Proceeding to 25%.
emily: CS updated customers with workaround and timeline. No immediate escalations.
jordan: After fallback complete, we should add runbook steps: "If GitHub Actions outage blocks deploys, use self-hosted runners or manual image push; rotate CI token if 401s; use cached images." I'll file a post-incident action item.
maya: Also consider adding alternate package registry mirrors and prebuilt artifacts cached in S3 to reduce dependency on GH packages.
liam: Noted. Thanks y'all — I'll keep the channel updated.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-15-GHAUTH updated to status: mitigated -> monitoring
jordan: Closing the page once we see 30m stable metrics. Last message from me at 15:20 UTC: leaving for meetings but available on pager.
liam: Will continue monitoring for 1 hour then hand back to next oncall.
sergio: Postmortem owner assigned: liam. Action items created: cache artifacts (P1), runner token rotation automation (P2), alternate npm mirror failover (P1).
emily: Thanks team. :tada:
